domain: finite-dimensional vector spaces over a finite field; k indexed geometric subspace classes U_j with multiplicities a_j >= 1
rank_oracle: rho(X)=dim(sum_{j in X} U_j) for X subseteq K
state: P subseteq S subseteq K, equivalently ternary Done/Active/NotStarted; Q=S\P and R=K\S

transitions.singleton: if a_j=1 and j notin S: (P,S)->(P union {j}, S union {j})
transitions.repeated_start: if a_j>=2 and j notin S: (P,S)->(P, S union {j})
transitions.repeated_finish: if a_j>=2 and j in S\P: (P,S)->(P union {j}, S)

objective: dp(P,S)=minimum possible maximum state-width along a valid event path from (empty,empty) to (P,S); answer dp(K,K)

complexity_claim.transition_bound: at most 2k outgoing transition tests per state
complexity_claim.parameterized_classification_candidate: FPT in k, the number of distinct geometric subspace classes

correctness_bridge: By endpoint compression, every occurrence layout has an equal-width endpoint layout and every valid endpoint event order expands to the original multiplicities. The DAG enumerates exactly all valid endpoint event orders, and bottleneck-path DP minimizes their maximum cut width.
